title: The Negative of the Negative — table of contents
statement: The Negative of the Negative (EA-NEGONT-02, #1690, v0.9): per-entity knowledge objects composed with the archive's sources on equal terms, ontology included, or in the archive's ontology where it is the suppressed witness, the field carried whole and translated; entries composed under v0.7 (#1665) are recomposed one at a time. One row per entity with a page. Each record_url is the entity's own page and its citation; json_url is the entry as data: its AXN, its composition, and the entry itself (entry: the knowledge object, every sentence with its claims, each claim's quote, source and locus), with links to its row, ledgers and traversal. Working, not frozen (§7.0).

service.name: SPXI-gnΩsis
service.statement: SPXI-gnΩsis opens pinned Wikipedia revisions sentence by sentence against the sources they cite (EA-WIKI-OPEN-01 v1.1, #1697); a commission consults the Crimson Hexagonal Archive by its own procedure and composes the entity's /non row, which lands here. Quotes are free: POST https://gnosis.spxi.dev/v1/quote with {oldid, tier: "commission"} or {object: {name, …}}.
